designationHistory.name: Copalis Rock Reservation
designationHistory.indexText: Theodore Roosevelt signed Executive Order 704 reserving the small islands off the Washington coast between latitudes 47°8' and 47°29' North, including Copalis Rock, as a preserve and breeding ground for native birds and animals.
designationHistory.note: Same day T.R. also signed Executive Orders 703 (Flattery Rocks) and 705 (Quillayute Needles). Renamed Copalis National Wildlife Refuge by Proclamation 2416, dated July 25, 1940 (APP); the CCP gives July 30, 1940 for the renaming.
